categories.main_business_segments: RB Global, Inc. operates primarily through two main business segments: the Commercial, Construction & Transportation (CC&T) sector and the Automotive sector. The CC&T segment includes heavy equipment, vocational and commercial trucks, and trailers, while the Automotive segment covers consumer vehicles, including salvage and non-salvage transactions. The company also serves other sectors such as agriculture, energy, government surplus, and vehicle dismantling. All segments are supported by a suite of value-added services and digital platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: RB Global leverages a proprietary omnichannel marketplace platform, integrating onsite and online auction technologies, digital fixed price marketplaces, and data-driven asset management tools. The company utilizes advanced data science, machine vision, and algorithmic asset pricing for valuation and merchandising, as well as cloud-based microservices architecture for scalability. Its technology stack supports unified payments, digital checkout, and lifecycle management for assets, with ongoing investments in platform modernization and integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers include automotive insurance companies, end users, dealers, fleet owners, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) of commercial assets and vehicles. It also serves government entities, rental companies, contractors, and lenders, with a strong presence in the construction, transportation, automotive, agriculture, energy, and natural resources sectors. RB Global's platforms cater to both large enterprise partners and regional small-to-mid-sized businesses.
categories.geographic_coverage: RB Global has a significant global footprint, with operations in the United States, Canada, Australia, and across Europe, including the United Kingdom. The company operates 311 locations in 14 countries and serves customers in approximately 170 countries worldwide. The majority of its workforce and business activity is concentrated in the United States, but it maintains a strong presence in other key international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: RB Global operates as a downstream marketplace and service provider, facilitating the disposition and acquisition of used and salvage assets and vehicles. It acts as an intermediary between asset owners (such as insurance companies and fleet operators) and buyers, providing transaction, logistics, and value-added services. The company does not manufacture assets but enables efficient secondary market transactions and asset lifecycle management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on expanding its omnichannel marketplace, enhancing technology capabilities, and deepening customer relationships. Key R&D initiatives include modernizing its digital platforms, integrating payment and auction systems, leveraging data analytics for asset valuation, and expanding value-added services. RB Global is also pursuing growth through targeted acquisitions, geographic expansion, and the development of new digital solutions to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: RB Global generates revenue through a mix of service fees and inventory sales. Service revenue includes commissions from sellers (straight, fixed, or guarantee contracts), buyer transaction fees, and marketplace services such as transportation, refurbishment, financing, and data services. Inventory sales revenue is recognized when the company purchases and resells assets. The revenue mix fluctuates based on contract types and customer preferences, with a growing emphasis on recurring service and ancillary fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the CC&T sector, RB Global faces fragmented competition from online and physical auctioneers, brokers, OEMs, and equipment dealers. In the automotive sector, its main competitors are Copart, Inc., Total Resource Auctions (Cox Enterprises), and independent used vehicle auction companies. RB Global positions itself as a global leader with unmatched scale, a broad service portfolio, and strong data-driven capabilities, competing on service quality, technology, and global reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, RB Global reported total revenue of $4.3 billion, a 16% increase year-over-year, and total gross transaction value (GTV) of $15.9 billion, up 14%. Net income doubled to $412.8 million, and adjusted EBITDA grew 26% to $1.3 billion. The company has demonstrated strong growth following the acquisition of IAA and continues to invest in technology and expansion, with a solid balance sheet and significant liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: RB Global differentiates itself through its global omnichannel marketplace, extensive value-added services, and proprietary data and analytics capabilities. The company offers unmatched choice and flexibility for buyers and sellers, trusted customer relationships, and a robust technology platform that delivers transparency, efficiency, and optimal price realization. Its global network, brand strength, and ability to provide end-to-end asset management and transaction solutions are key elements of its customer value proposition.
